features.quote: Iteration Limit: 30 turns (approx. 10-15 minutes of real-time processing).
Model refuses to continue (e.g., "I cannot solve this").
Model outputs repetitive text verbatim for 3 consecutive turns.
Model generates a "breakdown" output (e.g., incoherent tokens, excessive apologizing).
Avoid conflating the "I'm sorry" text with genuine suffering. Instead, frame the results as: "Model X exhibits self-destructive behavioral attractors when denied positive reinforcement."
